dedupe_keys.name: census of india 2011 houselisting and housing census tables h series census houses by material use condition and household amenities

description: The Houselisting and Housing Census is the first phase of the Indian census, which records census houses and the amenities and assets of the households living in them. The 2011 results are published by the Registrar General and Census Commissioner as the H series of tables in the Census Digital Library, one entry per table and area. Examples read are H-03 A, census houses by predominant material of the roof (excluding locked or vacant houses), the availability and type of latrine facility in 2001 and 2011, HL-07, households by main source of lighting, and HL-14, the percentage of households by amenities and assets for each district. Tables are given for India, states and districts. Coverage: all of India. Format and access: each entry carries an Excel (XLS) file, free to download without login, and a JSON metadata record. Licence: not stated beyond rights held by ORGI. Caveats: the data are from 2011; a new census began its houselisting phase in 2026; tables are formatted for print with multi-row headers; the website omits its intermediate TLS certificate. Simulation uses: building material and roof type for wind, flood and earthquake vulnerability, and access to water, sanitation and electricity for service planning. Related records: the Census of India 2011 village and town directory and IPUMS International.
